purpose: 事務職・オフィスワークの記事用の装飾アイキャッチ
prompt_brief: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an original landscape 16:9 editorial cover for a Japanese career media, to sit beside a series of warm ivory desk illustrations with navy tote bags and blank notebooks. Contemporary refined editorial illustration with soft daylight, subtle paper grain and tactile matte surfaces. Warm ivory, navy and muted periwinkle blue, sage and a tiny apricot accent. Subject: a calm office workstation seen at a slight overhead angle; a slim open navy laptop with a completely blank light blue screen, a short orderly stack of pale blue paper folders, one small ivory desk telephone and a single sage plant. Three or four large recognizable objects fill central 75 percent. Elegant sparse arrangement readable at 110px thumbnail. A gentle pale blue wall and daylight in the background, no room full of objects. Approachable for Japanese adults in their 20s and 30s exploring office jobs. Not glossy 3D, not clipart, not photoreal stock office. No people, faces, hands, text, letters, numerals, logo, watermark, charts or invented UI. Keep the laptop and telephone entire within the frame, small negative space around edges. Generate one finished cover.
